https://devjohn.site/about/
About John Mwaura
I am John Mwaura, known online as Dev John, an independent web and software developer in Kenya. I have worked since 2023, building business websites, online stores, custom software and automation. I also founded ABC Systems. I work across the full product: what a visitor sees, the database behind it, the APIs that connect it to other tools and the deployment. That can mean a small website with a clear enquiry route, or a business application with accounts, reports and payment workflows. My work starts with the task someone needs to complete. A shop customer wants to find an item and place an order. A member of staff needs the right information to do their job. A citizen looking through public spending needs records that are understandable and searchable. Those needs shape the interface and the code. Quick facts Name John Mwaura Also known as Dev John or Dev.John Location Kenya Working since 2023 Main work Websites, online stores, custom software and automation Languages and tools TypeScript, JavaScript, React, Next.js, Node.js and PostgreSQL Time zone East Africa Time, UTC+3, without daylight saving Reply time Within 24 hours Contact mwaura.ke.john@gmail.com What I build For a business website, I focus on clear service information, useful pages and an easy next action. A visitor on a phone should be able to understand what you offer and contact you without searching through a crowded layout. See my business website development service . An online store has a different job. Products need categories and useful details, and the cart, checkout and order handling need to fit the business. I work with M-Pesa and Stripe where they suit the agreed scope. My e-commerce development page explains the starter store. Custom software brings forms, business rules, reporting and an admin interface together around a specific workflow. I build dashboards and internal tools as well as public applications. Read about custom software development and the difference between a small scoped project and a larger platform. Automation connects actions that would otherwise need repeated manual work. That can include capturing an enquiry from WhatsApp, sending an order notification or syncing information with an existing tool. The WhatsApp automation service covers those possibilities. How I work These are the four principles on my homepage. They apply whether the project is a landing page or a platform with a database and integrations. I choose the technology after understanding the business problem and keep the whole path to launch in view. Business Problems Before Technology I start with the problem and the people, then pick the tools. End-to-End Ownership Database, APIs, deployment and maintenance, all handled. Built for Real-World Usage Mobile-first, payment-ready and practical. Performance, Security & Reliability Maintainable code that stays fast, safe and stable. Languages and tools I use React, Next.js and TypeScript for interfaces, and Node.js, PostgreSQL, Supabase and Prisma for backend work. Docker and GitHub Actions are part of the deployment tools on my homepage. M-Pesa Daraja and the WhatsApp Cloud API connect applications to payments and customer conversations. Website and software pricing
My website prices start at KSh 10,000 or $100 for a landing page. These are starting prices in KSh and USD, and the final price depends on the scope agreed. Larger platforms need a custom quote. Choose a starting package Each package below has the same scope and starting figure as the homepage. Use the row to compare what you need, then send me the requirements. The package name helps start the conversation; the written scope defines the work. A catalogue showcase and a checkout-enabled shop, for example, need different functionality. Feature Landing Page Basic Website Business Website Professional Website E-commerce Website Custom Software Advanced Platforms and Custom Products Pages 1 Up to 3 Up to 5 Up to 8 Store scope Agreed scope Agreed scope Responsive layout Included Included Included Included Included Included Agreed scope Enquiry form Included Included Included Included Agreed scope Business forms Agreed scope WhatsApp button Included Included Included Agreed scope Agreed scope Agreed scope Agreed scope Basic SEO setup Included Included Included Included Agreed scope Agreed scope Agreed scope Shop features Not listed Not listed Not listed Catalogue showcase Catalogue, cart, checkout, orders Agreed scope Agreed scope Admin interface Not listed Not listed Not listed Not listed Basic store admin Where required Agreed scope Deployment and handover Not listed Not listed Not listed Not listed Not listed Included Agreed scope What changes the final price Page count affects how much information needs a layout and how many pages need review. A single focused page has a different scope from a site with separate pages for several services. More custom design also means more decisions about the structure, content and presentation. Integrations such as M-Pesa or Stripe bring payment flows into the project. The required connection, the provider access and the behaviour after a payment all need to be described. An admin area can range from a small set of forms to several staff roles and detailed reports. For a shop, the number of products and the information attached to each product affect the work. Product variations, stock handling and order workflows should be discussed before treating them as included. The starter package lists a catalogue, categories, cart, checkout, order management and basic store administration. Content needs are part of the conversation too. Tell me whether the wording, product details and photos are ready, or whether writing and photography still need to be arranged. Let me know your intended deadline so we can discuss it with the rest of the scope. No delivery time is promised by these package prices. How a project runs Message me with the business goal and the kind of website or software you need. We discuss the requirements and agree what the project covers. You get a written quote for the agreed scope. I build the website or application around those requirements. You review the work and we discuss it against the scope. The project moves to launch. A useful first message explains who will use the result and what they should be able to do. If you already have a site, include its address and explain the part that needs attention. This gives the discussion more substance than choosing a package from the price alone. KSh and USD figures I show both currencies together so local and overseas clients can compare the published starting points. The exact figure is confirmed in writing when the scope is agreed. The two displayed figures are package starting prices, not a live exchange-rate calculator. For clients outside Kenya, the international project guide explains remote communication and time zone overlap. The project enquiry form includes budget and timeline fields, so you can send the context with your message. Pricing questions What is the lowest starting price? The Landing Page package starts at KSh 10,000 or $100. It covers one responsive page, WhatsApp and click-to-call buttons, a contact or enquiry form, basic on-page SEO and clear calls to action. How much does a small business website cost? Basic Website starts at KSh 15,000 or $150 for up to 3 pages. Business Website starts at KSh 20,000 or $200 for up to 5 pages. The final choice depends on the information and functionality you need. What does an online store start at? E-commerce Website starts at KSh 35,000 or $350. The exact payment integration and store requirements are agreed per project. Is custom software always KSh 40,000 or $400? No. That is a starting price for smaller, clearly scoped projects. Marketplaces, SaaS, booking platforms, complex API work and other advanced products need a custom quote. Is a product catalogue the same as a shop? A catalogue showcase presents products or services. A shop also needs a cart, checkout and order handling. The Professional Website package lists a showcase; the E-commerce Website package lists those shop features. Can M-Pesa or Stripe change the scope? Yes. Payment integration needs to match the checkout and business workflow. Tell me which payment flow you need so the connection can be included in the agreed quote. Can I discuss the budget before choosing a package? Yes. Send the business goal, required features and your budget through WhatsApp, email or the project form. I reply within 24 hours. Are these final fixed prices? No. Every figure is a starting price. The final price depends on the functionality and scope agreed, and the exact amount is confirmed in writing. I work from Kenya with local and international clients. What to send in your first message Tell me what the business does and what you want the website or software to help someone do. You might need a service website, an online shop, an internal dashboard or a WhatsApp workflow. A short explanation of the problem is enough to start the conversation. For a new business website, mention the services or products you want to show and whether your logo, photos and page text are ready. The form asks about your budget and intended timeline. Those answers give context for the scope discussion; they do not set a delivery promise or a final price. The website and software pricing guide shows the published starting packages in KSh and USD. https://devjohn.site/privacy/
Privacy policy
This page explains how devjohn.site handles information sent through the project form and contact links. I use the information you send to read and reply to your enquiry. You can contact me by email to ask for deletion. Information in the project form The form asks for your name, email, phone number, company, service, budget, timeline and project message. The company field is optional. Please include the project details needed for an enquiry and avoid sending passwords or other access credentials. The form is sent through Web3Forms . That service processes the submission so it can be delivered to me. Its privacy policy describes its own handling of submitted information. WhatsApp, email and external links WhatsApp links open WhatsApp, sometimes with a draft message you can edit before sending. Email links open your email application. Those services handle the messages you send through them under their own policies. Links to GitHub, LinkedIn, live projects and ABC Systems take you to other websites. The contact form does not submit when you simply follow one of those links. Browser storage and resources The site stores your light or dark theme choice in your browser using local storage. You can remove it through your browser settings. The site does not include an analytics script or a tracking cookie banner. Page fonts load from Google Fonts. Technology icons on the homepage and About page load from a public CDN. These resource requests go to those providers when your browser loads the resources. Deletion requests Email mwaura.ke.john@gmail.com if you want to ask about or request deletion of information you sent to me. Include enough context to identify the enquiry. Do not send additional sensitive details for this purpose. Tell me what you want to build Send a short description of the business, the people who will use the website or software, and the part you need help with. I reply within 24 hours.
